# Evidence (generated by CI, never edited by hand)

Per release folder `evidence/<release>/`:
- `eval-report.json`        G3 results vs thresholds
- `rai-report.json`         G4 results
- `traceability-matrix.json` REQ -> verification -> result
- `gate-records.json`       G0-G7 status, approvers, timestamps, artifact links

Synced to the central evidence store that feeds the consolidated dashboard.
